scope: Confirm native system improvements independently of unaccepted arithmetic candidates
generation: Nonstream HTTP, same original 2/9 image payloads, fixed18/64 greedy output, two excluded warmups per cell, ten measured repeats per cell, one second idle outside HTTP timer
primary_deployment: One uniform native inprocess+UniExecutor+prefill_interval2 configuration, chosen for the navigation short-output target before this run
additional_control: FP16 interval4 is retained as a separate complete deployment because exploratory data shows a long-output scheduling tradeoff; do not splice cell minima into an invented configuration
quiet_condition: All agents stop CPU tooling before launch and until run completes; root performs only bounded small status reads. No checkpoint mmap, imports, PNG decode, source preparation or compilation from other jobs during measured sessions.
correctness: All same-weight fixed input and output token sequences must agree; graph/executor/launch-table/source receipts independently audited
statistics: Keep all requests and outliers. Summarize each independent round separately; do not pool P95 or characterize n10 as statistical significance.
claim_separation: Same-model new versus old is system improvement
Quantized versus FP16 under equal optimized conditions is quantization advantage
Standalone kernel or vision candidate screening is not an accepted deployment result

excluded_candidates.wide_all: Observed unstable two-image64 output in one of ten repeats; full-model gate not met. No adoption or benefit claim.
excluded_candidates.wide_prefill_only: Four-cell outputs agree but initial HTTP benefit is small; not selected for this system-only confirmation.
excluded_candidates.vision_qmax: AWQ screen showed little HTTP improvement; complete FP16 result and independent numerical audit pending at plan registration.
excluded_candidates.hybrid: Not yet GPU tested; dependency on the rejected wide-all reference prevents current acceptance.
excluded_candidates.vision_cache: Implementation research only; not part of this confirmation.
